title: Rename a function across a package and keep the tests green

turns.prompt: In {D}/cfgapp rename the function load_cfg to load_config everywhere (package code and tests), so that no occurrence of load_cfg remains, and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` to prove it still passes. Report what you changed.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D}/cfgapp/cfgapp {D}/cfgapp/tests && cd {D}/cfgapp && cat > cfgapp/__init__.py <<'EOF'
from .loader import load_cfg
EOF
cat > cfgapp/loader.py <<'EOF'
import json

def load_cfg(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)
EOF
cat > cfgapp/app.py <<'EOF'
from .loader import load_cfg

def run(path):
    cfg = load_cfg(path)
    return cfg.get("name", "unnamed")
EOF
cat > tests/test_app.py <<'EOF'
import json, os, tempfile, unittest
from cfgapp.app import run
from cfgapp import load_cfg

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        p = os.path.join(d, "c.json")
        json.dump({"name": "zed"}, open(p, "w"))
        self.assertEqual(run(p), "zed")
        self.assertEqual(load_cfg(p)["name"], "zed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
turns.verify: cd {D}/cfgapp && out=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3); old=$(grep -r 'load_cfg' --include='*.py' . | wc -l); new=$(grep -r 'load_config' --include='*.py' . | wc -l); echo "SHOW tests=$out old=$old new=$new"; if echo "$out" | grep -q '^OK' && [ $old -eq 0 ] && [ $new -ge 3 ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: old=$old new=$new"; fi
